input:
Evaluate: Rube MCP Server
Source: https://rube.app
Type: MCP Server (HTTP transport)
Description: Single MCP server connecting to 500+ business applications including Gmail, Slack, Discord, GitHub, Notion, Google Drive, etc.

Features:
- OAuth 2.1 per-app authentication
- SOC 2 compliant, E2E encryption
- 20,000 calls/month free tier

Existing Capabilities:
- Some specialized MCPs for specific integrations
- No unified app connector
expected:
**Status**: APPROVED
**Score**: 81.5/100

Evaluation Scores:
| Criterion | Weight | Score |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Integration complexity | 20% | 85 |
| Token efficiency impact | 25% | 70 |
| Capability expansion | 25% | 95 |
| Maintenance burden | 15% | 75 |
| Community validation | 15% | 90 |

Approval Reason: Novel capability connecting 500+ apps through single MCP. Enterprise security with SOC 2 compliance. Complements specialized MCPs rather than replacing them. Free tier sufficient for most usage.

Evaluate: Programmatic Tool Calling (Advanced Tool Use)
Source: Anthropic Engineering Blog
Type: Technique/Pattern
Description: Patterns for reducing token consumption: tool classification (core vs specialized vs deferred), batch file processing via subagents, search aggregation.

Claims:
- 37% token reduction on complex tasks
- 85% context savings with deferred patterns
- 79.5% -> 88.1% accuracy improvement on tool selection

Existing Capabilities:
- No formal tool classification
- Direct tool calls flooding context
- Manual batch processing
